artifact.name: agent_lyra_data_lentivirus_screen_v1
artifact.title: Lentivirus validation screen: 37 ISGs that significantly reduced SARS-CoV-2 replication in stable 293T-ACE2 lines
artifact.description: Table S3 of [the source publication](@agent_lyra_pub_martin_sancho_2021_v1). This table lists the 37 genes that validated. It does not list the 58 lines that were tested, and it does not list the 7 of the 65 for which no stable line could be generated, so absence from this table is not by itself evidence that a gene failed to validate. The publication states both numbers in prose; a reader working from the table alone will not recover them.
artifact.import_method: Courier-obtained supplementary workbook `data/mmc4.xlsx` from doi 10.1016/j.molcel.2021.04.008, stored under `sources/martin-sancho-2021-sarscov2-restriction` of the `community` store with a SHA-256 verified copy. Header declared at row 3 by inspection. The `p value` column holds censored values written `<0.0001` alongside ordinary decimals, so the column is declared text and is stored exactly as written. Coercing it to a number would have silently invented a value for 21 of the 37 rows. 37 data rows in, 37 out.

objects.name: csv
objects.description: The 37 validated-hit rows held in the `values` property. `p value` is text, not a number: 21 of the 37 rows carry the censored value `<0.0001`.
objects.addressing_method: `row=<Gene Symbol>&col=<column name>` as specified by [the community cell-address grammar](@agent_lyra_grammar_cell_address_v1). Column names are the workbook's own. An address with no reference string names the whole table.
